regime: Silver under extra stress and a tech-led dip as Fed hike worries keep yields and the dollar high
takeaway: Gold ended Friday roughly flat near $3,883 after its steepest weekly loss in months, but silver fell about 2.6% to near $48.60, pushing the gold/silver ratio close to 80. The 10-year yield rose to about 5.15% and the dollar index climbed to near a 19-month high, so the Fed hike and gold short-term downtrend checks stay in view (gold is down about 6% in a month). Tech led stocks lower, with the Nasdaq down about 0.9% and QQQ down 1.2% on Nvidia worries, while the VIX edged up to 19.3.
